subject: proj
title: PROJ.------INTL.
description: Diagram in T(AF)M-17, on the page where Braxton argues that 'the actualness of black creativity functions as the most efficient generator for American creative culture, supplying either the base dynamics or vibrational identity for practically every American creative thrust involving music or dance.' (C)PROJ (projection) is crossed with INTL (intellectualism): the question is what happens to projection — black creativity's outward force into American culture — when it is processed through the western intellectualism that defines and re-interprets it. PROJ branches: → INTL (the crossing); → PRI-AF-TO (primary affinity tendencies) → P-PROG (particular progressionalism); → MT-INTR (multiple interpretation) → INFO-DY (information dynamics) → IST-S-ALGN (isolated systematic alignment) → LG-DY (logical dynamics); → (r)INT (the reality of intention), which branches to POL-DYM (political dynamics) and to IF-ST-DY (infra-structure dynamics) → LK-IMP (linkage implications). The argument: black creativity's projection into American culture, read through multiple interpretation, passes through information dynamics and isolated systematic alignment before reaching *logical-dynamics*.
